item.title: Base Layout Planner
item.description: The Core Keeper base layout planner collects blueprint references for building efficient bases — functional zoning, automated production lines and circuit wiring. Use the diagrams as a starting point, then adapt to your seed and resources. Blueprint categories Early base — compact starter shelter near the Core Farm layout — crop plots, sprinklers and food production Automation — conveyor loops, drills and sorting lines Defense — walls, traps and boss-arena prep FAQ Can I submit my own base?

item.title: Boss Drop Finder
item.description: The Core Keeper boss drop finder shows the full drop table for every boss — main bosses and optional bosses — including drop chances and how to summon or unlock each fight. How to use Select a boss (Glurch, Ghorm, Hive Mother, Azeos, Omoroth, Ra-Akar, Malugaz and more) to see its drops, unlock conditions and biome. Boss drop finder 7 bosses Search bosses by name, biome or drop item, filter by biome and tier, then select a card to see the full drop table and unlock condition.

item.title: Boss Loadout Generator
item.description: The Core Keeper boss loadout generator pairs every main boss (Glurch, Ghorm, Hive Mother, Malugaz, Azeos, Omoroth, Ra-Akar) with a ready-made gear plan — weapon, armor set, accessory, food and potion — matched to the ore tier of its biome. Recommendations are pulled from the official wiki’s per-boss “Recommended gear” sections and cross-checked against our own crafting data, so every item listed is something you can actually craft or farm in that stage of the game.

item.title: Core Keeper Crop Profit Calculator — Best Crops by Profit Per Hour
item.description: Which crop makes the most money per hour in Core Keeper? This crop profit calculator ranks every verified crop by profit per harvest cycle — sell value and fixed 10-minute growth time, filterable by ground type so you can plan farms for Dirt, Beach and Crystal biomes. Every crop takes a fixed 10 minutes from watered seed to harvest (2 sprout + 4 grow + 4 mature). Profit below assumes manual harvest and self-grown seeds — adjust seed cost to your own runs.

This Core Keeper drop chance calculator works out loot probability for every boss and creature with an indexed drop table — pick a source, set your kill count, and read off the chance of at least one drop and the expected loot per farm run. item.title: Core Keeper Fishing Filter — Every Fish by Water Type & Catch Chance
item.description: Every fish in Core Keeper, filterable by water type and sortable by catch chance. This fishing filter combines the full fish compendium with interactive controls — tick the biomes you’re fishing in, search for a specific fish, and sort to plan your collection or your next cooking run. Browse every fish by water type — tick the biomes you fish in, search by name, and sort by catch chance to plan your collection.

item.title: Core Keeper Food Buff Planner — Find the Best Food & Buff Combos
item.description: Wondering which food gives the biggest melee damage, or what to eat before a boss fight? This Core Keeper food buff planner matches any buff you want to the food, snack or potion that provides it — filtered from the full ingredient table, with the exact effect values and duration shown. Pick the buff you want, and we list every food, snack and potion that provides it. Same-type buffs do not stack in Core Keeper — only the highest value applies, while different buff types can be combined freely.

item.title: Core Keeper Mod Compatibility Checker — Find Mods for Your Build
item.description: Which Core Keeper mods work on your setup? This mod compatibility checker lets you filter the 22 most popular mods by platform and category, shows download counts, and points you to each mod’s official page to confirm compatibility against your exact game version (site baseline 1.3.0.6). Filter the 22 most popular Core Keeper mods by platform and category. Compatibility is checked on each mod page — always confirm against your exact game build (site baseline: 1.

item.title: Core Keeper Pixel Art Tool — Convert Images to Pixel Art Online
item.description: Turn any picture into a Core Keeper pixel art blueprint. Upload an image, choose your grid size, and this pixel art tool converts it into a blocky pixel canvas with an automatic color palette — ideal for planning in-game pixel murals, billboards and farm layouts, and it runs entirely in your browser. Upload any image and convert it into a blocky pixel-art canvas — perfect for planning in-game pixel builds (billboards, farms, pixel murals).

item.title: Core Keeper Recipe Backtracker — Total Materials Calculator
item.description: Need 5 Iron Bows but don’t know how much raw ore to mine? This Core Keeper recipe backtracker takes any craftable item and quantity, walks every recipe level and tells you the exact total of each raw material to gather — bars, planks, glass and beyond. Pick a craftable item and a quantity — this backtracker expands every intermediate ingredient (bars, planks, glass…) down to the raw materials you actually need to gather.

item.title: Crafting Simulator
item.description: The Core Keeper crafting simulator turns your backpack into a bottleneck analysis. Pick a target item, type in what you are already carrying — raw ore, smelted bars, wood, fiber — and it computes how many copies you can actually craft right now, which step of the chain stalls first, and exactly how much more of each material you must gather. Where the item crafting calculator answers “what do I need to craft N of this?

item.title: Creature Lookup
item.description: The Core Keeper creature lookup is a fast reference for every regular mob — health, damage, drops and where it spawns. Type a name to filter the list instantly. How to use Type in the search box to filter creatures by name. Each card shows biome, HP, damage, drops and a quick tactical note. Creature lookup 52 creatures Search regular mobs by name, biome or drop item. HP and damage bars are normalized against the strongest creature in this dataset.

item.title: Item Crafting Calculator
item.description: The Core Keeper item crafting calculator expands any recipe into its full crafting tree. Pick a target item and a quantity, and it recursively breaks every intermediate material down to raw ingredients — ore, bars and wood all the way to what you actually need to mine or gather. How to use Choose the item you want to craft. Set the target quantity. Read the raw ingredient summary (total ore / wood needed) and the crafting tree showing each intermediate step with its station (Furnace, Smelter Kiln, Anvil, Workbench).

item.title: Resource Efficiency Calculator
item.description: The Core Keeper resource efficiency calculator estimates how much ore you gather per minute and per hour, based on your pickaxe tier. Use it to decide when to upgrade tools or how long a mining run will take. How to use Choose the ore you are mining. Pick your pickaxe tier (Copper to Scarlet). Press Estimate to see ore/min and ore/hour. Resource Gathering Efficiency estimate Estimate raw ore yield per minute / hour with a given pickaxe tier, and compare all five pick tiers on the ore you picked.

item.title: Seed Finder
item.description: The Core Keeper seed finder helps you pick a good world seed before you start. Every world is generated from a numeric seed — it determines biome rotation, boss spawn arcs and fixed scenes, while terrain details are generated chunk-by-chunk as you explore. How to use Enter a numeric seed and hit Preview Layout to see the deterministic ring structure: the Core in the center, the inner ring (Clay Caves + Forgotten Ruins, 150–450 tiles), the Great Wall (450–520) and the three outer biomes (520–1200).

item.title: Skill Planner
item.description: Plan your Core Keeper skill build before you commit XP. Drag the sliders for all 12 skills to see the exact bonus each level grants, and how many skill points (1 per 5 levels, 20 at level 100) your build unlocks. Skill Planner 12 skills · max 100 each Drag levels to preview your build. Every 5th level grants +1 skill point (20 total per skill at level 100). The shareable link below encodes all twelve levels.
